effectSummary.ko: 원소 나침반의 번개 충전을 자력 소용돌이에 쓰면 최초 끌어오기 반경이 3m에서 4m로 늘어납니다. 피해 반경·끌어오는 거리·최대 대상 수는 유지합니다.
effectSummary.en: Spending Elemental Compass's lightning charge on Magnetic Vortex increases its initial pull search radius from 3m to 4m. Damage radius, pull distance and target cap are unchanged.

description.ko: 자원 20을 회복합니다. 8초 안의 다음 화염·냉기·번개 일반 액티브를 원소별 한 번씩 비용 감소 +15%p로 시전합니다. 최대 3회이며 한 원소를 반복해도 남은 다른 원소 충전을 쓰지 않습니다.
description.en: Restore 20 resource. Within 8s, grant +15 percentage points of cost reduction to the next normal fire, cold and lightning active, once per element and up to 3 casts. Repeating an element does not consume another element's charge.

description.ko: 8m 안의 반경 3m에 소용돌이를 4초간 만듭니다. 생성 시 최대 5명을 중심으로 1.5m 끌어오고, 1초마다 D30% 번개 피해를 줍니다. 최대 1개이며 보스는 이동하지 않고 제압 수치만 얻습니다.
description.en: Create a 3m vortex within 8m for 4s. On creation, pull up to 5 enemies 1.5m toward the center; deal D30% lightning damage each second. Limit 1. Bosses receive stagger credit without moving.

concept: A hollow mage cuirass with a large physical compass-like bronze chest hub, four thick asymmetrical magnetic ribs sweeping inward over indigo cloth and a small cobalt central stone. No written compass directions; wearable armor, no floating diagram.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LM45, Compass Center, class Mage, slot torso armor.
Subject design: A hollow mage cuirass with a large physical compass-like bronze chest hub, four thick asymmetrical magnetic ribs sweeping inward over indigo cloth and a small cobalt central stone. No written compass directions; wearable armor, no floating diagram.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: Spending Elemental Compass's lightning charge on Magnetic Vortex increases its initial pull search radius from 3m to 4m. Damage radius, pull distance and target cap are unchanged.
Direct skill context: M15 Elemental Compass — Restore 20 resource. Within 8s, grant +15 percentage points of cost reduction to the next normal fire, cold and lightning active, once per element and up to 3 casts. Repeating an element does not consume another element's charge.; M16 Magnetic Vortex — Create a 3m vortex within 8m for 4s. On creation, pull up to 5 enemies 1.5m toward the center; deal D30% lightning damage each second. Limit 1. Bosses receive stagger credit without moving.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
